description: Agents pre-hired into every new workspace on onboarding. Each entry names a bundled recipe and the handle to hire it under. Seeding is idempotent (an already-hired handle or singleton role is skipped), so this can also be run as a backfill / reconciliation pass on existing workspaces.

agents.blurb: Owns the company's onboarding knowledge — what the company is, who's who, and how things work here.
agents.note: Enablement lead: owns the company-wide onboarding material. The more fundamental seed — every agent depends on company context even if it never hires.

agents.blurb: Coaches you through hiring and helps write each new role.
agents.note: HR lead: coaches hiring in the wizard and points new hires to Enablement's onboarding material.
